text: Hello and welcome to this live commentary for the Premier League fixture between Tottenham and Fulham from the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Tottenham will look to return to the top of the Premier League today with a win to keep their incredible league start under Ange Postecoglou going.

Spurs are unbeaten through nine league games - drawing twice - and host London rivals Fulham looking for three wins on the spin after consecutive wins over Liverpool and Luton Town prior to the international break.
Fulham, meanwhile, have enjoyed a solid, if slightly unremarkable start to their second season in the Premier League under Marco Silva.
They sit 12th but lost just one of their last five games in all competitions before the international break, most recently winning 3-1 at home against Sheffield United.
They face a tough task against Spurs, though, and have historically struggled in league games against London clubs, failing to win any of their last 10 encounters (D4, L6).
Postecoglou makes just one change from his side that won 1-0 against Luton.
It's an enforced switch as Hojbjerg comes in for the suspended Bissouma who was sent off in that fixture.
Silva, meanwhile, makes two changes to his Fulham side that won 3-1 over Sheffield United.
In central defence, the injured Diop is replaced by the returning Bassey, while Lukic comes in for Iwobi in midfield.
Tottenham have won 13 of their last 15 Premier League games against Fulham, with the exceptions both coming in home games (0-1 in March 2013, 1-1 in January 2021).
Fulham get this first half under way!
SAVE! A great early chance as Maddison slips through Son on the left side of the area.
The Spurs captain looks to toe poke it across goal but it's denied well by Leno.
Play is called back for an earlier foul as Spurs have a free-kick just outside the area.
Maddison tries to play it short to Udogie but the Italian's touch lets him down and Fulham can clear.
A real fast start from Spurs but Fulham now have a moment to take a breather after Son is caught offside on the edge of their box.
Another robust challenge on Maddison - this time from Palhinha - as Spurs are awarded another free-kick on the left side.
Maddison's clipped ball finds Romero at the back post.
The Argentine nods it back into the centre of the area but the effort eventually goes over the bar after his centre-back partner Van de Ven can't keep his strike down.
Wave after wave of Spurs pressure at the minute as they win another foul, this time a matter of centimetres from the penalty area when Porro is brought down by Robinson.
Maddison rolls the ball back to Kulusevski, but the Swede's strike is blocked by the onrushing Fulham defence.
Fulham break up the pitch for the first time this game as De Cordova-Reid finds space on the right side.
His low ball is looking for Vinicius in the box but it's cleared out for a corner by Romero.
SAVE! A superb save from Vicario who is at full stretch to his left to deny Palhinha's thumping header and keep his side level.
A great chance for the visitors.
An action-packed start with four shots in total inside the first 14 minutes.
Spurs have had the lion's share of possession, though, with the home side enjoying 68 per cent of the ball in the opening stages.

Spurs are pressing with great intensity and Bassey almost loses the ball in a treacherous position but, in the end, the visitors recover well and win a foul when Porro brings down Willian around the halfway line.

A good burst from Castagne down the right side, but his cross into the box is slightly behind Vinicius and the Brazilian can't generate the right angle from the header as the ball drifts out for a goal kick.
Another corner for Fulham as Romero deflects Robinson's corner behind, but the set-piece comes to nothing as Vicario claims the cross well.
Fulham have found a way to contain Spurs' attacks better since that chaotic start but Postecoglou's side continue to attack with great intensity in front of this frenzied home crowd.
Lukic tries his luck from quite some distance, but it's a poor effort which tribbles comfortably wide of the post.
Maddison rolls the ball to Hojbjerg on the edge of the box but the Dane's effort is straight at Leno who holds on to the well-hit strike.
WIDE! Spurs break with blistering pace down the right as Kulusevski drives into the space vacated by Robinson who was committed up the pitch.
The Swede cuts inside onto his left before finding Richarlison but the Brazilian's curling effort from the edge of the box just misses wide of the left post.
Another chance swiftly after for Son but the Spurs captain can't catch the shot cleanly and it's an easy save for Leno.
Richarlison finds Udogie's surging run into the box, but Bassey blocks away the full-back's low cross as the referee waves away appeals for handball.
Maddison has been influential again, so far this game, and gets the ball again on the left side.
He cuts inside, onto his right foot, but the low effort is saved by Leno at his near post.
The first booking is shown to Hojbjerg after a mistimed tackle on Willian.
GOOOALLL!! TOTTENHAM LEAD! 1-0! Spurs have the breakthrough and it's the captain, Son, with the goal.
Fulham lose the ball cheaply in defence and it's Richarlison who capitalises on the loose ball.
He finds Son, who shifts the ball inside onto his right foot before unleashing a vicious curling effort into the top corner from the edge of the box.

events.action: curling effort into the top corner

text: Richarlison reacted quickest to the loose ball and found Son who made no mistake.
Forward Spurs come again as Bassey makes a vital header to direct Kulusevksi's cross away from the expectant Son, who was ready to nod home from close range.
Maddison's low, fizzing cross is cleared away by Fulham.
CLOSE! Another flowing move from Spurs who are so close to a second.
Son's deft flick sets up Udogie who sees his effort blocked by Ream inside the area before Kulusevski's follow-up shot is somehow blocked behind by Palhinha just metres out from the goal.
De Cordova-Reid's header is deflected behind for a corner by Udogie as Fulham have a chance to send their centre-backs forward.
It's a good cross from Pereira but he's caught in an offside position when the ball comes straight back to his feet.
A teasing cross from Richarlison cant quite find the outstretched boot of Porro inside the box.
Willian is caught in two minds on the edge of the Spurs box and that slight uncertainty allows the Tottenham defence to make the tackle on the Fulham winger.
Spurs now make a surging run into the box through the unlikely source of Romero.
The ball is eventually cut back by Kulusevski onto the penalty spot but Fulham make a vital interception with both Son and Richarlison looking to get a strike on goal.
Hojbjerg goes down after a collision with Bassey in the area.
The Spurs players appeal to the referee but after a brief VAR check, his decision is upheld and no penalty is awarded.
HALF-TIME: TOTTENHAM 1-0 FULHAM
A frenetic first half draws to a close with Son's goal the difference as Tottenham take a 1-0 lead into the break.
Postecoglou's side started fast and could have been ahead inside two minutes but for Leno's superb save to deny Son.
The visitors then had a great chance to go ahead themselves, but Palhinha's header was superbly saved by Vicario.

Richarlison saw an effort drift just wide of the post, but the Brazillian was eventually involved in Spurs' opening goal, feeding Son who drilled home a wonderful curling effort from the edge of the box.
The hosts had chances to extend their lead before the break but were denied by a number of well-timed blocks from Fulham who did well to ensure they remain just one goal behind.
15 shots in total between both sides after an action-packed first half in north London.
Spurs had ten with four on target and may feel they should be further ahead given their 66 per cent possession.
Fulham have looked dangerous at periods but Silva will want his players to avoid the same errors after the break that afforded Spurs so many chances in the first half.
A double change from Fulham at the break as Vinicius makes way for Jimenez up top.
In central midfield, Iwobi comes on to replace Pereira.
No changes for Spurs who get this second half under way now.
A slightly slower start to this half as Udogie is brought down by De Cordova-Reid inside the hosts' half.
Palhinha's wonderful long ball almost finds De Cordova-Reid on the edge of the box, but the Fulham winger fails to control the ball and the ball escapes him.
Kulusevski's neat spin allows him to beat Robinson on the right wing.
He feeds Son, who plays in Richarlison on the left edge of the box, but the Brazillian ballons his effort well over the bar.
Fulham win a free-kick centrally, but the clipped cross just evades Palhinha inside the box and the Spurs defence can clear it away.
GOOOOAAAALLL!! TOTTENHAM HAVE A SECOND! 2-0! A Fulham mistake is punished again as Maddison doubles the home side's lead.
Bassey again gives away the ball cheaply in the right corner as Hojbjerg makes the interception.
The loose ball falls to Son, who slides through Maddison and the Englishman makes no mistake, calmly finishing past Leno to give Spurs a two-goal advantage.
Son gets an assist to add to his first-half goal as he plays through Maddison who finished low past Leno.
A change after the goal for Spurs as Udogie makes way for Emerson at left-back.
A chance for Fulham to respond quickly from a corner but Spurs do well to clear the threat away.
Sarr retreats well to clear away Castagne's cross with Jimenez well-placed to head on goal.
A slight pause in play as Sarr goes down in the middle of the pitch.
Sarr will make way for Spurs as Skipp comes on to replace him in central midfield.
Fulham also make another change as Wilson comes on for De Cordova-Reid.
Fulham have had 57 per cent possession in this second half but have, thus far, failed to register a shot on goal.
Kulusevski again opts against having a shot in a good position and his eventual attempted pass is intercepted on the edge of the box.
Palhinha fouls Hojbjerg as Spurs win a free-kick in a wide-right position.
Maddison swings in an enticing cross but Son's flicked header at the near posts drifts across goal and out for a goal kick.
Another change for the visitors as Lukic is replaced by Reed in central midfield.
CLOSE! Bassey is almost punished for a third time this game as a heavy touch allows Maddison to sneak in and nick the ball inside the area.
The defence recovers for block his eventual effort before Richarlison blazes over from a tight angle.
Despite having less possession this half, Spurs have done an excellent job of controlling the tempo since going two goals ahead.
Fulham have barely threatened to get back into the game since conceding that Maddison goal.
A slight pause in play as Richarlison and Wilson both take a tumble after a collision but the pair are back up on their feet now and play can continue.
Some more late changes for Spurs as Richarlison makes way for Johnson in the forward line.
Spurs' second goalscorer, Maddison, also makes way with new signing Veliz introduced to the action.
And now Son, the home side's other scorer, heads to the bench as Lo Celso comes on in his place.
Fulham, too, make a change as Palhinha comes off for Cairney in midfield.
Robinson delivers a fierce cross from the right, but it's cleared away by the retreating Emerson.
SAVE! Vicario makes a huge save down low to his right after Jimenez is found on the right side of the box.
Spurs were appealing for a foul in the build-up but nothing doing for the ref so it's a vital stop from the Italian.
Vicario is the first player to be shown a yellow card this second half.
A nice backheel from Jimenez presents Cairney with a chance from an acute angle but Vicario saves easily at the near post.
Spurs break as Lo Celso looks to feed Veliz but the young striker doesn't quite time his run and is caught offside.
Into the first of seven minutes of added time in this second half.
Robinson's cross find Wilson deep on the right side, but the Welshman's eventual effort is blocked well by Emerson.
Wilson surges through on goal but he can't quite find the space and time for the eventual shot as Emerson recovers to make a vital block inside the box.
FULL-TIME: TOTTENHAM 2-0 FULHAM
A clinical Tottenham punished two Calvin Bassey errors to return to the top of the Premier League with a 2-0 home win against Fulham.
Heung-min Son's first-half strike gave the hosts the lead before James Maddison punished another error from the Fulham centre-back, cooly converting past Bernd Leno having been slid through by Son.
Maddison almost found a third after another mistake from Bassey before Guglielmo Vicario denied any hope of a late comeback with a smart save to deny Raul Jimenez's effort.
Ange Postecoglou's side remain unbeaten in the league and travel next to Crystal Palace for another all-London clash on Friday.
Fulham, meanwhile, extend their winless run against London clubs but have a chance to get back to winnings ways next Sunday when they travel to face Brighton.
Thank you and goodbye!
